column1: # mcu pins: what `mcu setup install <group|name>` installs into toolchain/ (checked 2026-10-29).
# sha256 from the publisher's checksum file where one exists (buildtools .sha256sum, cmake SHA-256.txt, Arm .sha256asc,
# xPack .sha, probe-rs .sha256, Renode pins of 32_06); other release archives: sha256 of the archive installed here.
# Git pins are commits (version column = tag/branch). Groups: core, bare, pico, stm32, wch, flash, sdks, ide (CLion GoogleTest).
# Not pinned (installed by hand, see toolchain/<sdk>/README.md): k230 (repo sync of manifest-frozen-20261023.xml,
# ~8 GB), the avr cores (arduino-cli core install), the bouffalo Xuantie toolchain, host private libs (host/README.md).
